sources.title: A Useful Four-Valued Logic
sources.supported_overlap: Distinguishing inconsistent and incomplete evidence has a long formal history.
sources.implication: Binary evidence states are an implementation/diagnostic, not a new logic.

sources.title: The Symbol Grounding Problem
sources.supported_overlap: Arbitrary symbols require grounding beyond further arbitrary symbols.
sources.implication: Glyph relabeling and digit classification do not solve general grounding.

sources.title: A Circumplex Model of Affect
sources.supported_overlap: Pleasantness and arousal are established affect dimensions.
sources.implication: F in [0,1] is a coding convention, not novel affect theory or truth.

sources.title: Provenance Semirings
sources.read_scope: primary PDF, abstract and recursive Datalog sections
sources.supported_overlap: Annotations track derivations; recursive provenance has algebraic and fixed-point treatments.
sources.implication: Provenance plus recursion alone is not a novel contribution.

sources.title: An assumption-based TMS
sources.supported_overlap: Assumption sets support reasoning across inconsistent alternatives.
sources.implication: Context/dependency tracking requires comparison with truth-maintenance approaches.

sources.title: Go for a Walk and Arrive at the Answer (MINERVA)
sources.read_scope: primary full-text methods and evaluation passages
sources.supported_overlap: Learned query-conditioned graph traversal predates SRDE; evaluation includes leakage precautions.
sources.implication: Path traversal, multi-hop inference and unseen relations are established.

sources.title: Neural Bellman-Ford Networks
sources.supported_overlap: Generalized path products and sums are learned through Bellman-Ford-style computation.
sources.implication: Recursive path composition needs an operational difference from established graph inference.

sources.title: Learning from Time-Changing Data with Adaptive Windowing
sources.read_scope: primary extended draft, introduction and algorithm passages
sources.supported_overlap: Adaptive windows address drift with statistical error bounds.
sources.implication: A better reset threshold, decay or window is not itself a fresh research problem.

sources.title: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
sources.supported_overlap: Online run-length posterior and predictive distributions handle abrupt changes.
sources.implication: Bayesian state/change uncertainty must be included among conventional alternatives.

sources.title: Change with Delayed Labeling: When is it Detectable?
sources.supported_overlap: Studies which changes can be detected before labels arrive.
sources.implication: Label delay and detectability are established topics; detailed method comparison remains open.

sources.title: Delayed labelling evaluation for data streams
sources.supported_overlap: Evaluation must respect label latency; prediction refinement can be evaluated over time.
sources.implication: Timestamp guards are necessary evaluation practice, not evidence of originality.

sources.title: Active feature acquisition on data streams under feature drift
sources.supported_overlap: Selects whether and which missing feature to acquire under cost and changing streams.
sources.implication: Budgeted adaptive evidence collection under drift already exists.

sources.title: Investigating Delays of Combined Feature and Label Acquisitions on Data Streams
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and conference-hosted full chapter, methods/evaluation/conclusion
sources.supported_overlap: Combines feature and label queries, costs, missingness and delayed responses on streams.
sources.implication: Adding delayed queries to acquisition is insufficient novelty. Full chapter recovered from conference proceedings.

sources.title: Conformal Inference for Online Prediction with Arbitrary Distribution Shifts
sources.read_scope: publisher abstract and primary PDF retrieved
sources.supported_overlap: Adapts prediction sets to distribution shift.
sources.implication: Online uncertainty adjustment is established; probability calibration and set coverage are distinct.

sources.title: Truth Discovery and Copying Detection in a Dynamic World
sources.read_scope: primary PDF, model and evaluation passages
sources.supported_overlap: Models source freshness, quality, evolving copying and changing true values.
sources.implication: Temporal provenance-aware truth discovery is especially close prior art.

sources.title: Less is More: Selecting Sources Wisely for Integration
sources.supported_overlap: Trades information integration quality against source acquisition and integration costs.
sources.implication: Selecting fewer useful sources and considering marginal value is established.

sources.title: Active multi-fidelity Bayesian online changepoint detection
sources.supported_overlap: Selects measurement fidelity through information gain per cost for change detection.
sources.implication: Cost-sensitive sensing plus drift is not a fresh combination by itself.

sources.title: Learning-To-Measure: In-Context Active Feature Acquisition
sources.supported_overlap: Acquires features using uncertainty and conditional mutual information under missingness and scarce labels.
sources.implication: Recent acquisition methods belong in the comparison search; detailed implementation review remains open.

scope: Targeted prior-art review, not an exhaustive systematic review. Read scope is explicit. No third-party PDFs are redistributed.
